context.summary: Thallium-texaphyrin-lipid conjugates self-assembled by microfluidics with DPPC, cholesterol and DSPE-PEG2000 into liposome-like nanotexaphyrins to chelate and deliver Auger-emitting 201Tl3+; characterized by DLS, zeta, TEM, UV-Vis, stability and uptake in cancer cells.

samples.name: Tl-nanotexaphyrins (natTl)
samples.composition: Tl-texaphyrin-lipid 10-20% mol, DPPC 34.4-44.4%, cholesterol 40.6%, DSPE-PEG2000 5.0% (total molar lipid)

samples.name: Tl-texaphyrin-lipid conjugate
samples.composition: nonradioactive Tl3+ chelated by texaphyrin-lipid, in ethanol

values.morphology: homogeneous particles (images only, no size measured from TEM)

conditions.prep_state: carbon-coated copper grid, negatively stained with 2% uranyl acetate

evidence.quote: (c–f) TEM images of Tl-nanotexaphyrins in PBS at 80,000 magnification (scale bar: 200 nm) and 200,000 magnifications (scale bar: 100 nm).
The measured zeta potential was slightly negative: −1.5 ± 0.4 mV (n = 3).

measurements.measurand: hydrodynamic diameter and PDI of Tl-nanotexaphyrins (text mean 147.4 nm; representative z-average in Fig. 5b 152.4 nm, PDI 0.167)

evidence.quote: average hydrodynamic diameter of 147.4 ± 1.4 nm and a PDI of 0.15 ± 0.03 (Figure 5b–f)

measurements.measurand: absorption bands of Tl-texaphyrin-lipid complex (Soret-like and Q-like)
measurements.assay_purpose: chelation confirmation / spectral characterization of the conjugate

evidence.quote: characteristic absorption Soret-like and Q-like bands at 465 and 760 nm, respectively (Suppl. Figure 3b,c)

si_mentions.quote: characteristic absorption Soret-like and Q-like bands at 465 and 760 nm, respectively (Suppl. Figure 3b,c)

articles.notes: Stability series (Table 1) DLS in PBS at 4/25/37 C up to 72 h; zeta medium not stated; UV-Vis done on pure Tl-texaphyrin-lipid, not on nanoparticles.
